definition: Normal support witness W with support size greater than 8 or an already-reduced witness still above the selected boundary.
input_witness_condition: W finite and in support normal form
caveat: Does not prove such witness always has compressible motif.

definition: W has an accepted canonical motif M and compression candidate M_comp.
compressible_motif_condition: M_comp lower in canonical order and preservation preconditions declared
caveat: Preservation preconditions are not full theorems.

definition: Find canonical mismatch or redundant canonical row structure with lower-rank representative.
compressible_motif_condition: M is compressible if accepted reduction row exists
relation_to_higher_support_escape: no accepted row -> no-op later operation
caveat: Detection is under declared contract, not exhaustive search.

definition: Replace M by M_comp and reindex affected motif-local fields.
support_effect: support may drop if fields vanish
relation_to_family_chain_lift: may preserve family-chain source form conditionally
caveat: Rewrite soundness for arbitrary rows remains proof-sketch.
Output candidate is well-defined under normalization contract.

definition: Compression never increases support under accepted rule.
compressible_motif_condition: M_comp uses subset or same support
compression_rule: rewrite cannot introduce new support atoms
caveat: Support nonincrease proof outside accepted rule remains sketch.

definition: If support size is unchanged, canonical motif rank strictly decreases.
caveat: Rank comparison is selected contract, not global completeness.

definition: Selected support tuple decreases if support decreases or support is fixed and canonical rank decreases.
canonical_measure_effect: negative lexicographic delta under fixed earlier components
caveat: Earlier tuple components must be fixed by operation preconditions.

definition: Normalize restores support normal form after motif rewrite.
output_witness_construction: W_comp in normal form by contract

definition: Compressed motif payload refines source motif payload if motif refinement precondition holds.
Compression must preserve status or produce smaller status-refuting witness.
compressible_motif_condition: status relation accepted or operation-specific reduction theorem available

definition: If W is recognized family-chain source form, compression must preserve recognizer or route to family-chain/non-family-chain blocker.
compression_rule: rewrite within recognized form if possible

definition: If no accepted compression or preservation proof is available, the failure is named and later routed to remaining operation or higher-support escape.
compressible_motif_condition: no accepted compression or proof missing

definition: Compression semantics are first-class and proof-ready with lexicographic measure decrease under accepted compressible motif precondition.
